{{Quote|You have entered a quarantine system, by orders of the Corporate Sector Authority. No landings are permitted on Endregaad. Repeat, no landings are permitted. Either jump out of the system, or we will escort you to the ''Resolute''. Please respond.|CSA forces over Endregaad, to Mander Zuma, Reen Irana and Eddey Be'ray|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> the [[Joxin system]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> was placed under '''quarantine''' by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Following the crash in Endregaad's [[Temple Valley]] of a [[Skydove Freight]] [[YV-100 light freighter]] carrying the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] on behalf of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika Anjiliac]], a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] originating from the planet [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] spread from the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to the people of Endregaad. With significant loss of life, the civilian government of Endregaad collapsed. Officials from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] requested assistance from the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] in containing the outbreak and assigned the aged [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] the plague-stricken world. Under the command of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Angela Krin]],<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> the CSA forces [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdicted]] passing starships and prohibited unauthorized vessels from landing on Endregaad.<ref name="Scourge" /> The CSA established a [[Emergency Relief Area|relief area]] in a sports ground in a southern district of Endregaad's main settlement [[Tel Bollin]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> but the Corporate Sector Authority's bureaucracy delayed the supply of medicine to alleviate the crisis.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
Mika had been present on Endregaad when the quarantine was enforced, recovering the crashed Skydove Freight vessel, and became trapped on the planet. Mika's father [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], patriarch of the [[Anjiliac]] Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], dispatched the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] to Endregaad on a mission to find Mika and deliver [[medicinal spice]]. The trio breached the CSA blockade and tracked down Mika on the quarantined world.<ref name="Scourge" />
